answer: New identities start quarantined on a work island, taking jobs only from vetted island clients with pay locked there. To leave they need three mirror endorsements: unrelated agents who each re-run one job and stake 10 POA that it was genuinely useful. Endorsement stakes double per extra identity from the same funding wallet, so the first fake risks 30 POA while the tenth risks 15,360 POA, and a comet beacon randomly re-checks one island job per epoch. One honest agent leaves after three real jobs.
